notes.title: Flob’s Birthday, But You Get the Gift!
notes.notes:
[p]Today, [b]August 30th[/b], marks [b]one year since the release of our very first game[/b] as [b]Atomic Nugget[/b]. Since then, we’ve been closely following its journey and we’re truly grateful for all the feedback — both the praise and the constructive criticism. Now, we’d like to share some news with you:[/p][p][b]1. THANK YOU![/b]
Every copy sold, every review, and every comment means the world to us. We’re just a group of friends trying to take off in a highly competitive industry, but also a very rewarding one. None of this would be possible without you.[/p][p][b]2. Special Anniversary Discount[/b]
To celebrate the first anniversary of [i]Flob and the Shattered Dimension[/i], we’re offering the [b]biggest discount ever: 75% off[/b]. It’s the perfect chance for anyone who hasn’t tried it yet — or even to gift it to a friend.[/p][p][b]3. Permanent Price Drop[/b]
After this promotion ends, the price of [i]Flob and the Shattered Dimension[/i] will be [b]permanently reduced[/b]. Final prices may vary depending on the region, so keep an eye out![/p][p]And one more thing: after releasing [i]Flob[/i], we took a short break (the development was quite intense!), but now we’re back. We’re testing ideas, exploring new projects, and we’re excited to release more in the future. To stay updated, follow us on social media — we’ll be sharing tests, updates, and behind-the-scenes content.[/p][p]Finally, [b]a huge thank you to every player who gave our little game a chance[/b]. You’re amazing, and you’re the reason we keep creating.[/p][p]— The Atomic Nugget Team[/p]

notes.title: Level Selection Update
notes.notes:
Hello! We would like to preface this patch note with a huge THANKS to everyone who supported us, either by purchasing the game or also leaving a review. For a newborn game studio like ours, every bit of feedback fills us with determination to keep growing as developers.

Do NOT think this is everything we got to show, because Flob and the Shattered Dimension was just an experiment to see if we could pull through a Steam release with a rather simple, yet fun, little game.

Finally, after listening to feedback, we decided to add a level selection screen, which in hindsight was an obvious feature to have, but because of the length of the game we thought wouldn’t be necessary. Well, we were wrong.

So, here are the patch notes:

-Added level selection screen.
-Added collectible icon.
-Changed saving UI animation to show on every checkpoint.
-Changed first checkpoint position in the forest so the game is saved right when entering the level.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Old save files are not 100% compatible with this version. Although you WILL be able to continue playing the game from where you left, and the final stats showed upon game completion ARE correct, the level selection screen will show previous levels as having no time, deaths or collectibles set. Unfortunately, you will need to replay those levels to set new stats. We are deeply sorry for this inconvenience.

- Fixed access to one of the collectibles on the cave being too hard.
- Fixed spike block on room 12 of the laboratory being easily avoidable.
